verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Gitea has an official CLI, 'tea', documented at gitea.com/gitea/tea, which delivers the core of the story. Beyond that probe, the pack says nothing about the CLI's commands, coverage, or agent-friendly features such as machine-readable output or non-interactive auth. Missing for 10: detailed first-party CLI documentation, evidence of command coverage and scriptable or AI-friendly output, independent or hands-on corroboration of tea usage.
